title: Claude optimizes token use by building a knowledge graph #Claude #tokenoptimization #AIdevelopment
description: The Claude token saver tool reduces token consumption by building a knowledge graph of your entire codebase. Instead of Claude reading files individually and using thousands of tokens each session, it reads the pre-built graph, making context loading more efficient. This approach significantly lowers costs and accelerates workflow when using Claude for coding projects. The tool integrates as an MCP server in Claude Code, set up in minutes, and is available for free on GitHub. It highlights how knowledge graphs optimize AI context handling, a critical advancement for developers dealing with large codebases. By minimizing token use, this solution supports scalable and cost-effective AI integration in software development. #ClaudeAI #TokenSaver #KnowledgeGraph #AIProgramming #ClaudeCode #MCPServer #GitHubTools #AICodeOptimization #SoftwareDevelopment #AIContextManagement #DeveloperTools #CodeEfficiency #ArtificialIntelligence
